The aggregate weight of ornaments pledged for all loans to a borrower shall not exceed 1 kilogram for gold ornaments (para 40(1), Chapter IV, Lending against Gold and Silver Collateral). Coins are capped separately, at 50 grams for gold coins (para 40(2)).

The minimum loan is Rs 5 lakh and the maximum is Rs 10 crore, subject to the LTV limit (DB-HL-009) and repayment capacity (DB-HL-011). For a Home Loan, DB-HL-018 sets the penal charge at 3% per annum, levied only on the overdue EMI amount for the days it stays unpaid. It is a charge, not an addition to the interest rate, and no interest is charged on it.

This rule implements RBI para 351. That clause requires default penalties to be levied as penal charges, not penal interest, and there shall be no capitalisation of penal charge

rows.expected_answer: 720; 700-719 only with a deviation
